description: Ask gocushy's own assistant a question about how gocushy works, or about this account's own numbers (revenue, orders, bump/upsell rates, setup gaps). Cush reads the shipped docs, the curated FAQ, and account-level AGGREGATES only — it can never return an individual buyer, email or order. It can also PROPOSE one of four changes (change a price, pause an offer, set an offer live, create a coupon): when it does, the reply carries an action_card block with a signed single-use token, the real before/after computed server-side, and any warnings. NOTHING has changed at that point — pass the token to cush_confirm to apply it, and show the human the card's before/after first. Pass conversation_id from a previous reply to continue that thread. Answers cost real money and count against this account's shared daily limit, so prefer the direct tools (get_sales, get_offer_stats, list_coupons…) when you need a specific number, and use Cush for 'how do I' and 'what should I do about' questions.
